reason: A hands-on educational DSH/Cordis plugin-development practice bundle demonstrating lifecycle management, tools, configuration, services, events, and waterfall middleware.

summaries.zh: 用于学习和实践 DeepSeek Harness/Cordis 插件开发的最小练习插件，涵盖生命周期、工具、配置、服务、事件和 waterfall 中间件。
summaries.en: A minimal hands-on practice bundle for learning DeepSeek Harness/Cordis plugin development through lifecycle, tools, configuration, services, events, and waterfall middleware.

capabilities: Provides example DSH plugin lifecycle, tool, configuration, service, consumer, event, and waterfall middleware implementations
Builds and installs the bundle into a local DSH profile
Runs local plugin behavior including workspace inspection, greeting, event emission, middleware transformation, and lifecycle logging
